{"description":"Read spec section, extract MUST/SHALL/SHOULD statements, create checklist in task description

## Extracted Requirements from 02-physical-link.md:4.4 and 06-security.md:15.3

### Counter Structure
- Counter = (EPO << 16) | SeqNum, range 0x000000 through 0xFFFFFF
- Uses unsigned integer ordering (NOT serial-number arithmetic)

### Sender Requirements (MUST)
- [ ] EPO MUST NOT wrap from 0xFF to 0x00
- [ ] After (EPO=0xFF, SeqNum=0xFFFF), sender MUST rotate link key before next authenticated frame
- [ ] On reboot/reset, sender MUST resume above its last used counter under current key
- [ ] Sender MUST NOT reset or wrap either component under that key
- [ ] When no persisted epoch available, MUST initialize epoch to random value in [128, 255]
- [ ] If sender cannot establish counter above last use, MUST rotate link key before transmitting

### Receiver Requirements (MUST)
- [ ] Receiver with replay state MUST apply normal numeric acceptance rules
- [ ] Receivers track per-sender (epoch, seqnum) state with 32-entry sliding window
- [ ] Receiver State per sender: IID, LastEpoch (8 bits), LastSeqNum (16 bits), Window (32-bit bitmap)
- [ ] Lower epoch MUST NOT be interpreted as wrap - always reject as stale
- [ ] SeqNum decrease within same epoch MUST NOT be interpreted as wrap

### Acceptance Rules (MUST implement)
| Received | Action |
|----------|--------|
| Epoch > LastEpoch | Accept, update state |
| Epoch == LastEpoch, SeqNum > LastSeqNum | Accept, update state |
| Epoch == LastEpoch, SeqNum in window | Accept if not seen, mark seen |
| Epoch < LastEpoch | Reject (replay) |
| Epoch == LastEpoch, SeqNum <= window floor | Reject (replay) |

### SHOULD/RECOMMENDED
- [ ] Implementations SHOULD persist epoch to flash or defer random init until after radio init (for weak RNG platforms)
- [ ] Epoch persistence RECOMMENDED (not required)
- [ ] If persisting epoch SHOULD: write to flash on every increment, use wear-leveling, fall back to random init on read failure"}

Extracted 13 MUST requirements and 3 SHOULD/RECOMMENDED items from spec sections 02-physical-link.md:4.4 and 06-security.md:15.3. Requirements include sender counter rules (EPO non-wrap, key rotation at exhaust), receiver acceptance rules with 32-entry sliding window, and epoch initialization/persistence guidance. Checklist added to description for implementation tracking.
